findings.label: Data guard fires too late
findings.description: src/data/index.js assigns `export const Data = window.Data` before the guard checks `!window.Data`. If window.Data is undefined at module evaluation time, all six named exports are silently bound to undefined before the guard throws. Move the guard above the export statements.

findings.label: window.Timetable bypass in parent.js
findings.description: _renderTimetableFor in parent.js (line 145) reads `const { Timetable: T } = window` instead of using the Timetable already imported from ../data/index.js. This silently produces empty timetables if window.Timetable is undefined. Replace with the module-level import and remove the T ? fallback.

findings.label: Static cycle: shared.js → router.js → admin.js → shared.js
findings.description: shared.js statically imports openModal from router.js; router.js statically imports view modules including admin.js; admin.js statically imports from shared.js. This is a circular static import chain that violates the stated no-circular-imports goal. Fix by extracting openModal/closeModal to a thin src/modals.js with no view imports.

findings.label: _sensitiveRun live-binding inconsistency
findings.description: state.js exports the raw `let _sensitiveRun` binding alongside a set_sensitiveRun setter, inconsistent with the getter/setter pattern used for every other state variable. A consumer that captures _sensitiveRun at import time will always see null. Add a getSensitiveRun() getter and stop exporting the raw binding.
